content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text characterizes Matthew 1:20 as answered by both sides, which is the kind of verse-status determination K-G4 governs.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.","room":"A verse the judge says was answered is not counted: reading one, saying it was answered excludes it without quoting a pressing sentence; reading two, even an answered verse must be tied to a quoted pressing sentence.","why":"The judge says Matthew 1:20 was answered on both sides and treats it as underdetermined, so it does not count the verse as an unanswered witness or toward a broken link, and the quote requirement for unanswered witnesses is not triggered."}
